SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........
S.I. Special Branch/ditch,
REPORT
Date May 18, 19 38
Subject Communication received from the British Consulate-General. Re:
Mr. B.M. Shick.
Made by D.P.S. Rogovenko Forwarded by

Boris Michaelovich Shick, Russian Jew, was born on
14.3.1890 at Wilno, Poland. He attended a high school in
Kiev, Russia, subsequently he studied Law at the University
of Kiev, graduating from same in 1911. He took part in the
Great War, 1914 to 1915 and served in Admiral Kolchak's
White Army for four years.
He arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok on 5.11.22.
In January 1923 he established the B and B Photo Studio,
conducting same for two years. In 1925 he joined Josepho
Photo Studio as a partner. During the same year he proceeded
to Tientsin and Peking in order to open branches. He remained
at those towns till 1929, when he left for Mukden and estab-
lished a similar business. Following the Mukden Incident in
1931, he liquidated his business and returned to Shanghai
on 9.10.31. In February 1932 he became the sole proprietor
of Josepho Photo Studios, at present holding premises at
61 Nanking Road and 937 Avenue Joffre.
He has two sons and two daughters. The elder son
is in business with him and the younger is a student. Both
his daughters are married, one to Inspector Gorlovsky of the
River Police and the other to H.D. Rodger of Rodger & Co.,
attorneys.
He intends to proceed to Hongkong in June in order to
make arrangements for establishing a photo studio.
He is registered with the Council of the United Russian
Public Organisation of Shanghai, (SORO). Nothing detrimental
is known by this office against him.

D.C.(Special Branch)    D.P.S.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号...........
特别情报科/沟渠，
报告
日期 1938年5月18日
事由 收到英国总领事馆来函。关于：
B.M. Shick 先生。
由 D.P.S. Rogovenko 制作 转呈者

鲍里斯·米哈伊洛维奇·希克（Boris Michaelovich Shick），俄籍犹太人，1890年3月14日出生于波兰维尔纽斯（Wilno）。他就读于俄国基辅的一所中学，随后在基辅大学攻读法律，并于1911年毕业。他参加了1914年至1915年的大战，并在高尔察克海军上将的白军中服役四年。
他于1922年11月5日从海参崴抵达上海。
1923年1月，他创办了 B and B 照相馆，经营了两年。1925年，他作为合伙人加入 Josepho 照相馆。同年，他前往天津和北京开设分店。他一直留在这些城市直到1929年，随后前往沈阳并建立了类似的生意。1931年九一八事变后，他清算了业务，并于1931年10月9日返回上海。1932年2月，他成为 Josepho 照相馆的唯一所有者，目前经营场所位于南京路61号和霞飞路937号。
他有两个儿子和两个女儿。长子与他一起经商，次子是学生。他的两个女儿均已婚，一个嫁给了水上警察局督察 Gorlovsky，另一个嫁给了 Rodger & Co. 律师事务所的 H.D. Rodger。
他打算于六月前往香港，为建立照相馆做出安排。
他在上海俄罗斯侨民公会（SORO）理事会进行了登记。本局未掌握对其不利的任何信息。

副总监（特别情报科）    D.P.S.
